verdict.rationale: Lago's docs say customers can upgrade or downgrade their plan at any time, and its API could serve as a base for a self-built flow. However, the evidence shows no hosted customer portal or embeddable components, so a founder would have to build the self-service UI on the API. Missing for 10: hosted customer portal, embeddable self-service components, self-service cancellation, any independent or hands-on corroboration of self-serve plan changes.
